subject: BrightFoundry: promo credit & trial extension – accounting routing
messages:
From: Elena Vargas <elena.vargas@brightfoundry.com>
To: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>
Cc: Accounts Payable <ap@brightfoundry.com>
Date: Sun, 15 Nov 2026 09:22:00 -0800
Subject: Request: promo credit & trial extension for integration delay

Hi Rishi,

Thanks again for the support this week. Quick note from our side: our integration ran into a delay with an SSO vendor and we missed the planned production cutover. Because of that BrightFoundry will not hit the expected usage in the upcoming invoice period.

Can Redwood approve the following: a 60-day trial extension plus a promotional credit of $12,000 applied against our next invoice? Our AP team requires a formal credit memo or amendment to accept the offset — they prefer it be explicit on the invoice.

We can sign an amendment if needed. Let me know what you need from our side (DocuSign, PO reference, GL mapping for our AR team).

Thanks,
Elena Vargas
Senior Program Manager, BrightFoundry
elena.vargas@brightfoundry.com

Attachment: integration_delay_summary.pdf (attachment stub)

From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>
To: Elena Vargas <elena.vargas@brightfoundry.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 16 Nov 2026 10:05:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Request: promo credit & trial extension for integration delay

Elena — thanks for the note and the summary. Sorry you hit that SSO snag. We can do a 60-day extension and we normally handle promo credits as a credit memo that offsets the next invoice.

Looping in Marissa (Finance) and Marcus (Revenue/Accounting) to confirm ledger treatment and whether we should issue a formal credit memo now or route a proforma allowance until the invoice posts. If AP needs a DocuSign amendment, we can send that as part of the package.

Proposed next steps:
- Accounting to confirm credit memo vs allowance approach and GLA mapping (Marcus)
- If credit memo: Billing to queue the CM and show offset on next invoice (Marissa)
- Elena: please attach the PO or preferred AP reference and we will include it on the amendment

Rishi
Sr. Account Executive, Redwood Inference
rishi_malhotra@redwood.com
Phone: +1 415-555-0173

From: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>
To: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 17 Nov 2026 08:30:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Request: promo credit & trial extension for integration delay

Thanks — tagging accounting guidance. For clarity: treatment depends on timing and whether revenue has been recognized for the affected period. Options:

1) If invoice has already posted and revenue is recognized: issue a credit memo and post a contra-revenue JE. Use contra-revenue GL 4020 for the customer-facing offset. Journal entry template attached.

2) If invoice has NOT posted yet: create a proforma credit allowance and map to Promo Allowance GLA 6175; recognize the allowance over the service period if the credit is considered a sales incentive.

3) If the customer explicitly requests invoice-level netting (their AP wants the invoice reduced): Billing can apply the credit memo at invoice generation and we will reduce recognized revenue accordingly.

For internal controls: require a signed amendment/DocuSign plus an internal approval (Finance owner sign-off). Limit approvals: credits <= $25k can be approved by Finance (Marissa); >$25k require VP sign-off. This one is $12,000 so Finance approval is sufficient.

Attachments: journal_entry_template.csv, credit_memo_draft.pdf (stubs)

Marcus Lin
Revenue Accounting Manager, Redwood Inference
marcus_lin@redwood.com

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 17 Nov 2026 11:02:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Request: promo credit & trial extension for integration delay

Agree with Marcus. Operational note for Billing/AR:

- Issue a credit memo for $12,000 referencing DF-4821 and attach the signed amendment.
- Ledger mapping: use Promo Allowance 6175 as the subledger reference and post the contra-revenue 4020 for the invoice offset line item.
- Attach the DocuSign link in the invoice package and include the customer's AP contact email on the memo.
- Once CM is posted, notify AP and update the AR record so the next invoice reflects the net amount.

Marcus: please confirm the JE code for the reversal date (use current period if refunding same month).

Marissa Cole
Head of Finance Operations, Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood.com
